newsitem.title: PERU: Red Cross official named negotiator in Lima drama.
newsitem.headline: Red Cross official named negotiator in Lima drama.

text.p: An International Red Cross official, Michel Minning, was appointed on Thursday as chief negotiator with Peruvian rebels holding hundreds of hostages at the Japanese ambassador's residence in Lima.

"Michel Minning of the International Red Cross has been appointed as the official negotiator," Canadian ambassador Anthony Vincent, who has been mediating between the rebels and the Peruvian government, told a news conference.
Minning, a Swiss national, has been in contact with the rebels inside the embassy compound since they stormed the residency late on Tuesday.
He has also helped take food and medical supplies to the building inside the compound where the rebels are holding about 400 hostages.

After spending about 30 minutes in the compound earlier on Thursday, Minning said the first priority was to supply the hostages with food and basic supplies such as toiletries. He said negotiations would start later Thursday.
Vincent was one of five diplomats released on Wednesday to form a channel of communication between the rebels and the Peruvian government.
